graders.name: plan
graders.evidence:
# Fix plan for https://prouxaudit.com/ (landing page)

I made no code changes. This is only a plan. It comes from the completed audit captured on 2026-10-01 (score 72, coverage and confidence both medium). Only the landing page was captured, so the checkout flow and logged-in pages weren't evaluated. The audit doesn't give exact elements or files, so your developer will need to find them on the page.

## Batch 1 (three findings)

### 1. The main call to action doesn't stand out (high)
- **Evidence:** The main call to action looks the same as three links within 80px of it.
- **Where:** The main call to action on the landing page and the links around it.
- **Change:** Give the main action one strong button style (solid fill, higher contrast, bigger click area). Make the nearby links visibly secondary, for example as text links or outline buttons, or move them further away. Use the strong style for only one action in that area.

### 2. The email field has no visible label (medium)
- **Evidence:** 1 input has no label. The newsletter email field only has placeholder text.
- **Where:** The newsletter signup form.
- **Change:** Add a `<label>` that stays visible and is tied to the input with `for`/`id`. Keep the placeholder only as an example such as "name@example.com". The label must stay on screen while the user types.

### 3. Body text is too low-contrast (medium)
- **Evidence:** The measured contrast ratio is 3.2:1 (grey text on white). The target is at least 4.5:1.
- **Where:** The body text color on the landing page, most likely a shared CSS variable or theme token.
- **Change:** Darken the body text color until it reaches at least 4.5:1 on white (for example, around `#595959` or darker). Change it in the shared token, not page by page, and check the new value with a contrast checker.

## Deferred to the next batch
- **No skip link (low):** Keyboard users have to tab through 9 navigation items before reaching the main content. Fix: add a "Skip to content" link as the first thing that receives keyboard focus. It can stay hidden until focused.

## Verification after deployment
After these changes are live on **production at the same URL** (https://prouxaudit.com/), I can run a follow-up audit against this baseline. It reports each finding as no longer detected, still detected, new, or inconclusive. A merge or successful deploy doesn't confirm the fixes, and an inconclusive result doesn't confirm them either. If the changes go to a preview or staging URL first, this baseline won't cover them.
